1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits a specific enolate reactivity or selectivity profile distinct from corresponding potassium salts in nucleophilic addition reactions__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is C1 -C12-alkyl, C6 -aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl and the sodium enolate exhibits enhanced regioselectivity in aldol condensation reactions compared to potassium analogs__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl, __wherein the sodium enolate salt demonstrates improved stability and selectivity in asymmetric transformations__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is sodium and the compound is prepared by a method comprising deprotonation of a corresponding ß-keto ester with sodium hydride or sodium alkoxide__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (II b) in which Z is sodium, __wherein the sodium enolate is formed in situ and exhibits superior reactivity in C-C bond forming reactions with electrophiles compared to pre-formed potassium enolates__.
